newsitem.title: UK: NWE naphtha swaps up $1; $192 Braefoot Bay deal.
newsitem.headline: NWE naphtha swaps up $1; $192 Braefoot Bay deal.

text.p: Higher crude futures values pulled up August naphtha swaps by $1 Wednesday to $185.50-$186.50 as September swaps rose by $1.50-$2 to late afternoon levels of $184.50-$185.

The physical market saw a fresh trade at $192 for a Braefoot Bay cargo for August 5-7 loading. The deal was broadly in line with a published high of $189, given that Braefoot Bay is condensate with high paraffinic valuye and current viewed by brokers $2-$2.50 above quoted highs.
The sale by a U.K. petchem player to a London-based trader was paralleled by continued trader indications that they would bid for open spec naphtha at $190.
August and September swap trades were heard concluded during the afternoon at $185.50 and $184 respectively, before a modest late surge.
